jobs.title: Commercial Strategy Manager
jobs.description: Overview About the role: This is a high‑impact strategy role at the heart of PepsiCo UKI’s Commercial function. As Commercial Strategy Manager, you will be the strategic right-hand to our Commercial Vice President and Sales Leadership Team, shaping the long-term commercial strategy, solving the hardest problems, and building the narratives that influence how PepsiCo shows up with its biggest customers. This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant looking to move into industry while retaining the problem quality, senior exposure, and pace of a consulting environment, with the added benefit of end‑to‑end ownership and delivery. Responsibilities What you’ll do: Shape the commercial strategy Partner with the Commercial VP and Sales Leadership Team as a trusted advisor on the most complex and ambiguous commercial questions. Lead the long-term and short-term commercial planning processes — growth outlook, sub-channel strategy, annual operating plan. Own the strategic outputs that define PepsiCo's commercial narrative: category strategy, customer narratives, and the growth story. Drive strategic initiatives from concept to impact Lead priority commercial initiatives end-to-end, from diagnosis and business case through to delivery and measurement. Own the governance, portfolio management, and integrated roadmap: milestones, risks, resources, and investment. Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure tangible commercial outcomes, not just strategic recommendations. Be the strategic go-to for Commercial Leadership Build the strategic storyline for internal and external forums. Act as a chief of staff to the VP of Sales, handling high-priority, time-sensitive requests with precision and judgement. Maintain a sharp external lens: consumer trends, competitive moves, macroeconomic and geopolitical shifts that shape the commercial agenda. Qualifications What you’ll bring: Consulting-grade problem structuring – you frame problems clearly, test hypotheses rigorously, and land on a "so what" that drives action. Comfort in ambiguity with senior stakeholders – you can walk into a room of Directors and VPs with a half-formed problem and leave with a clear path forward. Storytelling that drives decisions – you translate analysis into compelling, executive-ready narratives that shift the conversation. Bias to delivery – you don't just recommend; you own outcomes. You hold yourself accountable for commercial impact, not just strategic output. Intellectual curiosity – you stay on top of what's happening outside PepsiCo as much as inside it. You bring fresh thinking from other industries, markets, and categories. Requirements: 5+ years' experience, ideally including 3+ years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm or an FMCG in-house strategy / commercial excellence team. Strong commercial and strategic judgement. Proven ability to influence and operate credibly with senior leaders (Director / VP level and above). Outstanding analytical skills and structured problem-solving. Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive presentations for C-suite audiences. Ability to lead complex, cross-functional agendas autonomously in a matrixed organisation.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy Manager - Away From Home

Each of them plays an integral role in helping create deep connections between people and our products. Think about your last group celebration: chances are, one of our iconic brands was by your side. At PepsiCo, you’re invited to be a part of a global team of innovators who make, move, and sell these products—which are enjoyed by more than 1 billion people a day. A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where everyone’s welcome. Here, you can dare to be yourself. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you can influence the people around you and the world at large. By showing up, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, develop and grow your skills for the future. Our supportive teams can fuel your professional goals to make a global impact on people and the planet.Join us. Dare for Better PepsiCo Away From Home (“AFH”) is a division of PepsiCo that brings the company's entire portfolio of food and beverage brands to market in out-of-home consumption channels. The AFH operating environment is complex and highly dynamic, requiring diverse sales and go-to-market systems to meet consumer needs at work, at play, and on the go. PepsiCo AFH leverages the scale and breadth of the company's brands to provide a unified voice to its customers and deliver a competitive advantage in the fast-growing AFH channel. Responsibilities What’s Your Role? As a Sr. Strategy Manager on the AFH Strategy team is part of PepsiCo’s broader Strategy network and works globally across PepsiCo’s entire portfolio of beverages, snacks and nutrition. Our function plays a critical role in charting PepsiCo’s long-term growth and portfolio development, driving both the future of the company and shaping the industry landscape. AFH is a key enabler of PepsiCo’s strategy, serving as a source of profitable growth, a vehicle to build our brands, and a transformation accelerator. We are tasked with ensuring the company invests in the assets and capabilities needed to stay ahead of the competition, adapt to market trends, and maintain market leadership. This entails developing actionable solutions for some of the most challenging issues facing the company by influencing brand, innovation, equipment and channel priorities and by undertaking transformational initiatives (e.g., data & analytics, online ordering) to achieve the greatest possible growth and penetration. Our team primarily works across three types of projects: long term strategic planning, annual strategic planning, and growth priorities (e.g., channel / customer strategy, portfolio, etc.). What Will Make You Succeed: Employ solution-oriented mindset to help solve an array of PepsiCo’s most challenging, business critical, topics Translate business problems to structured projects that you will lead in end-to-end delivery against key objectives, from hypothesis development to final materials Lead analytical workstreams – identify and deconstruct business issues, and develop strategic, analytical, and financial frameworks to conduct analyses and solve critical business issues with minimal oversight from functional leaders Demonstrate strong leadership and influence management skills, including the ability to challenge the status quo Lead & manage teams to deliver on-time and complete deliverables Invest in the professional development of direct reports including coaching, performance reviews, and long-term career guidance Build executive-ready project deliverables Execute against time-sensitive requests from Executive leaders and cross-functional business partners Maintain an external mindset, including staying on top of consumer, competitive, and macroeconomic / geopolitical trends Contribute to capability building for the entire Global Strategy function (e.g., Recruiting, Training, Knowledge Management) Compensation and Benefits: The expected compensation range for this position is between $123,500 - $206,750. Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 15% of annual salary paid out annually. Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement. In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan. Qualifications Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree required 5 years of strategy experience either internally or with a Top Tier consulting firm Plus to have: MBA preferred 7 years of strategy experience either internally or with a Top Tier consulting firm preferred Expertise in competitive analysis, market trends, and food and beverage consumer behavior preferred. Experience in management consulting for CPG clients preferred. Passionate about the Consumer-Packaged Goods ("CPG") industry and love for our brands. Skills and Competencies: Strategic mindset with an ability to think broadly, refine questions, and develop analytical frameworks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable business strategies. Excellent technical skills to coach teams to analyze large quantities of data error-free. Outstanding project and people management experience with the ability to drive initiatives from concept to execution and a proven record of managing teams or projects cross-functionally. Demonstrated high emotional intelligence and strong ability to "manage up". Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to educate, engage, and influence senior executives and stakeholders. Global outlook with sensitivity and awareness of social and cultural differences. Proven ability to work collaboratively across different functions and regions. This position is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States. Role is open to professionals who can work from Purchase, NY. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. PepsiCo is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Female / Minority / Disability / Protected Veteran / Sexual Orientation / Gender Identity / Age. jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Manager - Korea
jobs.description: Overview Work for a global FMCG company with some of the world’s most trusted and iconic brands. Be part of an exciting business where employees are recognized and career growth is supported.  At PepsiCo, you can Dare for Better. You can help build a world where there are more possibilities for more people, no matter what role you hold. Together, we’ll make a positive impact for good. Because when we Dare for Better, we can smile at what’s next. For our careers, families, communities and the planet. The Corporate Strategy Manager - Korea accelerates growth across the North Asia beverage system by combining strategic insight, commercial analytics, and transformation leadership. This role serves as a strategic thought partner to the GM and a key interface with bottler partners, helping shape business priorities, resolve complex commercial issues, and drive sustainable value creation across the PepsiCo–bottler system. The role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking, analytical rigor, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to translate strategy into execution. Responsibilities What you will be responsible for: 1.Generate Strategic Insights Leverage commercial, market, consumer, and competitive insights to identify high-impact growth opportunities across categories, brands, channels, customers, and portfolio mix. Translate complex data and analytics into clear, actionable strategic recommendations for the holistic business strategy set up and execution. Develop fact-based perspectives on key business opportunities, risks, and strategic choices. 2. Data & Business Intelligence Own and connect key data sources, including internal shipment sales data, external POS, market share, consumer, and category analytics. Establish a fact base to support strategic decision-making and performance management. Continuously identify new data sources, consumer research data and analytical approaches to improve business understanding and decision quality. 3. Act as a Strategic Thought Partner to the GM & Bottler Leadership Partner closely with the GM and bottler commercial/RGM leadership to diagnose business challenges, shape strategic priorities, and influence decision-making through structured, data-driven insights. Bring an objective PepsiCo perspective while understanding and balancing bottler economics and business priorities. Challenge assumptions constructively and develop practical, mutually beneficial solutions to complex business issues. 4. Lead Franchise Governance & Bottler Negotiations Partner closely with the GM to lead the Franchise Governance agenda with bottler partners, ensuring alignment on strategic priorities, business performance, commercial plans, and critical franchise matters. Build trusted relationships with bottler leadership and proactively manage communication, alignment, and negotiation on key franchise agendas. Prepare and lead governance forums, including agenda setting, issue framing, decision making, and follow-up, in close partnership with the GM. Drive resolution of complex or potentially contentious issues by developing fact-based positions, understanding both PepsiCo and bottler economics, and negotiating sustainable outcomes. Identify potential areas of misalignment early and work with the GM and cross-functional teams to proactively address risks and unlock opportunities. Lead and/or coordinate key franchise agreements and governance matters, including Exclusive Bottling Agreement (EBA), Non-Compete Clause Compliance, Business Development Agreement (BDA), Concentrate Supply Agreement (CSA), Concentrate Price Change and other franchise-governance related matters. Ensure strong governance discipline, clear accountability, and timely follow-through on agreed actions and decisions. 5. Innovation Commercialization Build robust business cases and approval memos for new product launches and major commercial initiatives. Develop concentrate pricing recommendations based on PepsiCo and bottler economics (P&L Assumptions). Lead commercial discussions and negotiations with bottler partners to secure alignment, appropriate value sharing, and sustainable profitability. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure strategic innovations are translated into commercially viable and executable plans. 6. Lead Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives Scope and lead high-impact strategic projects across PepsiCo and bottler teams. Mobilize cross-functional expertise across Marketing, Sales, Finance, R&D, Supply Chain, Legal, and other functions to solve complex business challenges. Drive projects from problem definition through recommendation, alignment, execution, and measurable business impact. Lead transformation initiatives that strengthen commercial capabilities and the overall PepsiCo–bottler system. 7. Performance Management & Execution Establish strong operating rhythms, performance tracking, and governance mechanisms to ensure disciplined execution against strategic priorities. Monitor key business and commercial KPIs, identify performance gaps, and translate findings into actionable interventions. Enable rapid problem solving and cross-functional alignment to sustain delivery of business results. 8. Stakeholder Management Build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across PepsiCo and bottler organizations, from working-level teams to senior leadership. Effectively navigate complex organizational dynamics and different stakeholder interests. Communicate complex strategic and commercial topics with clarity, conviction, and executive presence. Serve as a bridge between PepsiCo functions and bottler teams to accelerate alignment and execution. 9. Ad-hoc Business Analysis & Strategic Problem Solving Own ad-hoc commercial, consumer, financial, and data analyses to support critical business decisions. Quickly structure ambiguous business questions, develop hypotheses, analyze available data, and translate findings into clear recommendations. Provide timely analytical and strategic support on emerging business issues and opportunities. 10. GM & Strategic Initiative Support Provide flexible, high-priority support to the GM across evolving business needs and strategic initiatives. Support the GM on critical innovation, commercial, franchise, organizational, and cross-functional priorities. Prepare executive-level materials, recommendations, and decision frameworks for senior leadership discussions and governance forums. Act as a trusted extension of the GM in driving follow-up, alignment, and execution on priority initiatives. Qualifications What you will need to have: +10 to 15years of experience in a multinational FMCG environment within Commercial or Strategy functions, NRM or RGM functions, Insight Functions for analytical or Consulting experience with exposure to FMCG. Bachelor’s degree in any relevant field from a reputable academic institution Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical capability with structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate data into actionable business insights Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear strategic storytelling and high-quality executive presentations Humble, growth-oriented mindset with strong ownership and a win-win solutions-driven attitude Collaborative working style with the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders Fluent in English, Korean language proficiency preferred. Additional Japanese language proficiency will be an advantage

jobs.title: 2027 Full Time: Strategic Finance Associate Manager- MBA
jobs.description: Overview SMILE AT WHAT’S NEXT At PepsiCo, you'll find the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and help shape what's next. As one of the world's leading food and beverage companies, our beloved brands—including Gatorade, Lay's, and Quaker—help create smiles with every sip and bite. Behind our products is a connected system that starts with how we source and grow ingredients alongside farmers and extends to how we make, move, and deliver products while driving positive impact for our business and communities. At the heart of PepsiCo are our people: professionals who bring curiosity, drive, and fresh thinking, working together to turn ideas into action. Across functions, teams, and markets, we collaborate to solve challenges, unlock new opportunities, and create meaningful impact for our consumers, customers, and communities. No matter your role, you'll be part of a connected community where your contributions matter, your voice is heard, and your development is supported. With opportunities to grow, belong, and smile, PepsiCo offers more than a place to build your career—it offers the chance to help create what's next. Mandatory Requirement: Please upload a cover letter and resume as one document via the Resume Upload section of the application. Responsibilities Functional Description: Put your financial experience to work for some of the world’s most beloved brands with a career at PepsiCo. With many billion-dollar brands sold in over 200 countries and territories around the globe, you’ll have opportunities to help shape the future of one of the world’s largest companies. PepsiCo Finance partners have a seat at the table across all facets and functions within the company. As a Finance professional, you’ll have the opportunity to explore a multi-disciplinary career path across a broad number of functions, and contribute meaningfully towards creating smiles for consumers, driving full-potential performance and achieving our Winning with Purpose vision. All finance roles are grounded in the following capability areas: Data‑Anchored Problem Solving – Using data, metrics, and structured analysis to define problems, assess trade‑offs, and enable informed decision‑making. Finance Culture & Capability Building – Fostering financial acumen, continuous learning, and strong ways of working while actively developing individual and team capabilities. Finance Through Digitalization – Applying technology, digital tools, and process improvements to deliver efficient, accurate, and scalable outcomes. Strategic Business Partnering – Partnering with stakeholders to understand business priorities, balance competing demands, and deliver insights that drive value. PepsiCo Finance is made up of the following functional areas across all divisions, unless otherwise noted: Brand and Marketing Finance builds annual and long-term strategic brand plans, prepares the business case for new innovation, and manages marketing budgets across all brands. Associates partner with Marketing and other cross-functional teams to build plans, allocate resources, and performance manage against KPIs. Financial Planning manages sector and corporate financial performance through action-oriented analytical insights and traditional financial tools. FP&A associates focus on the development of monthly forecasts, the annual operating plan, and the three-year strategic plan. FP&A partners with senior management to prepare presentations for the Executive Committee and Wall Street. Sales / Commercial Finance works with Customer Teams to drive sustainable revenue and profit growth with our customers. Sales Finance Associates build the revenue plan, working with Sales to optimize promotional spending and manage trade spend liabilities. They proactively manage portfolio mix to drive margin improvement. Revenue Management sets retail pricing and package architecture strategy, advises on customer portfolio strategy and optimizes trade spend. Revenue Management Associates assess consumer and category trends, the customer landscape, and the competitive environment to develop these recommendations. Supply Chain Finance manages the company’s product manufacturing and distribution strategies by analyzing production, labor, transportation, and selling costs. Supply Chain associates assess the historical and projected financial economics of producing and selling company products. Associates also evaluate productivity initiatives and perform capacity analyses to drive critical capital decisions and inform production planning. Mergers & Acquisitions is responsible for executing a wide range of transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic alliances. M&A associates get involved from the outset of a potential transaction and work closely with Corporate Finance and business units throughout the process.
